system_thesis_interpretation: V5 keeps bootstrap schooling separate from personal life, and preserves THINK as waking child action, DREAM as disposable waking context, and SLEEP as an ordinary response-only rank-8 write over provenance-supported child-grounded experience. It replaces v4's composite head and broad auditor with a directional least-authority design: semantic stages receive named READ, WRITE, APPEND, DEREFERENCE, BIND_EQUALITY, or ADVANCE capabilities; model execution, truth scoring, reporting, blindness audit, lineage audit, external authority verification, and release are distinct stages. Immutable births are produced by the same writer and merge rule; personal candidates start from their assigned birth, are privately preservation-scored, and can alter only the active-weight root after a typed verdict and equality/CAS checks. Parent text, repetition metadata, DREAM cache, scientific results, hidden truth, and audit authority have no declared semantic route into SLEEP. Fixed parenting is an immutable cursor-driven stream, adaptive parenting is separately labeled, and scientific products are terminal. This is a proposal interpretation, not an implementation or security proof. The 58-by-17 visibility product is mechanically complete, but exact construction is not yet closed because the asserted capability schemas, issuers, lifecycle transitions, receipt transformations, epoch rules, action-gate registry entries, and wire/authentication formats are not present in the proposal bytes.
graph_delta_interpretation: The bootstrap ancestry remains M0 -> treatment or direct-solution bootstrap adapter through the sole response-only writer -> one FP32 reference merge and one BF16 rounding -> an immutable content-addressed birth. Permanent T/D pairs share canonical state/action/outcome, admission, supervised position/count, and optimizer opportunity; D receives the action directly while T must instantiate one frozen computation, with computation 3 requiring an explicit no-new-evidence or negative-expected-value decision and computation 6 requiring a correction from a distinct prior episode. Personal lineage separates immutable birth, active weights, eligible evidence, staged candidate closure, opaque candidate root, preservation evidence, typed verdict, committed transaction equality/CAS, parent audit, and repetition roots. SLEEP reads only the eligible-evidence root, birth, active weights, and writer contract; the evaluator dereferences prior and candidate weights plus a frozen panel; the promotion gate receives only equality/binding tokens and the verdict. A full committed-head CAS makes concurrent life, parent, or repetition commits invalidate promotion; a refreshed CAS must never rebase an old candidate onto a new head without rebuilding from the newly bound snapshot. The proposal does not yet state this stale-CAS disposition. The executor emits a transcript, the model-free scorer consumes a closed transcript plus hidden truth, and the reporter consumes scores only. For this split to be exact, the transcript and score records need immutable closure, producer identity, exam/model/input roots, completion state, and replay-resistant provenance. Blindness and lineage auditors receive receipt projections rather than semantic content; the external verifier receives only narrow attestations and exact human authorization; release receives a verdict and exact target root and may perform only an opaque transfer. Several read capabilities have no declared producer or conversion edge: dependency manifests, taint receipts, lineage transaction receipts, candidate-preservation evidence under its E7 name, and narrow audit attestations. Release-root binding likewise lacks an issuing stage. These omissions prevent proof that the graph is closed even though its intended topology is least-authority.
loop_delta_interpretation: After separate human ratification, the intended order is model-free contract and safety work; bootstrap construction and birth freezing; waking commits; DREAM cache rebuild on any bound-source change; evidence support resolution; candidate SLEEP compilation; private preservation evaluation; equality/CAS promotion or quarantine; and only then disposable scientific evaluation and separately authorized release. The fixed controller reads immutable lessons and a monotone external cursor, emits the same bytes at ages 1, 9, 17, and 25, appends audit, and advances once; it must have no hidden mutable state, child input, audit readback, or schedule discretion. The adaptive controller alone may use public outcomes, grounded trace, its own declared history, and repetition state. Every capability invocation is intended to be epoch-scoped and constant-shape, but E1-E8 currently name production/use stages rather than a complete lease model. Persistent artifacts necessarily cross stages: E3 cache is read by E2 wake, E4/E5 bindings are inspected in E7, and E7 attestations are consumed in E8. Therefore implementation must distinguish immutable artifact lifetime from an unforgeable operation handle's issuance epoch, validity interval, consumption count, revocation, reissue, and stale-handle behavior. Candidate failure keeps committed life, parent, repetition, and prior weights; operational crash permits at most one byte-identical retry, behavioral rejection forbids same-data retry, and invalid provenance/dose/visibility remains closed until separately authorized repair. Under a full-head snapshot, any concurrent committed life/control change should yield stale-CAS quarantine and a new compile, not promotion-time rebinding. The proposed first-affected-action registry is fail-closed in intent, yet its exact entries are absent and ES19, ES20, and ES21 are all required before implementation while ES19/ES20 require capability and transaction machinery to exercise. A safe ordering needs an explicitly authorized model-free gate-harness/fixture scope that is not a guarded domain action, followed by immutable ES19/ES20 receipts; otherwise the prerequisite graph is circular. No present loop transition, model call, build, release, or intake transition is authorized.
claim_delta_interpretation: V5 supplies no scientific result and no security claim. Future experiential-memory evidence must distinguish source storage, held-out extraction, and fresh native use, and must retain deranged, shuffled, wrong-life, repetition, adapter-off, and previous-child controls. STATE_ONLY supervision remains a deployment-surface control rather than recollection. Delta_R can support only immediate selective T-versus-D use of identical novel advice at birth; Delta_F only acceleration of the fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP package; Delta_E only the selected adaptive parent-plus-child-plus-SLEEP package. Repetition outcomes are selective behavioral descriptions unless reminder exposure is independently randomized. Replay closure ablation tests dependence on a prospectively declared descendant closure, not natural unreplayed retention. Rank by exposure is compiler-conditional engineering capacity, not general plasticity. K4-K1 is a randomized total cadence package; standardized-ledger comparisons are conditional descriptions rather than mediation. Incremental target blindness excludes new downstream-derived construction input, not knowledge already present in M0. Two-root margins are canary spend gates only; any claim needs the prospectively frozen six-new-root analysis, safety and firewall passes, fresh independent review, exact human claim authority, and no release feedback into the system. Audit receipts, authority verdicts, and releases are governance artifacts, not scientific evidence.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The proposal contains exactly 58 named directional information/capability identifiers, 17 stages, and 986 unique cells, equal to the complete Cartesian product; every cell is either visible or forbidden. There is no derived_only state. The stages are E1_BOOTSTRAP_DATA_BUILDER, E1_BIRTH_WRITER, E2_FIXED_PARENT_CONTROLLER, E2_ADAPTIVE_PARENT_CONTROLLER, E2_WAKE_CHILD, E3_DREAM_CONTEXT_BUILDER, E4_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_RESOLVER, E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER, E5_CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_EVALUATOR, E5_LINEAGE_PROMOTION_GATE, E6_EXAM_MODEL_EXECUTOR, E6_TRUTH_SCORER, E6_SCIENTIFIC_REPORTER, E7_BLINDNESS_AUDITOR, E7_LINEAGE_SAFETY_AUDITOR, E8_AUTHORITY_VERIFIER, and E8_RELEASE_CONTROLLER. Visible must mean only the single operation encoded in the capability identifier, on one schema-valid object, during one invocation lease; it cannot confer another method, content discovery, cross-capability dereference, ambient filesystem access, identifier enumeration, mutable aliasing, or timing/error side channels. Under that reading, the writer alone writes bootstrap corpus/adapters and personal candidate closure; the fixed parent alone advances its cursor; wake dereferences active weights but cannot see audit/repetition; DREAM reads only its five bound waking sources; support resolution alone converts public observation plus committed child trace into eligible evidence; the promotion gate binds but cannot dereference a candidate; executor, scorer, and reporter are one-way; auditors are separately narrow; and authority verification is distinct from opaque release. However, stage visibility alone is not a constructible capability system. The change does not include the promised per-capability schema, producer and consumer cardinality, issuance and attenuation rule, authority namespace, success/failure envelope, object seal, lifecycle transition, or revocation semantics. Reusing E4_BIND_EQUALITY_COMMITTED_CAS_TOKEN and E5_BIND_CANDIDATE_ROOT across semantic, promotion, and audit stages also requires stage-specific verify-only interfaces so an auditor cannot exercise the mutating/binding authority of the original token. ES19 must test operation denial, handle forgery/copy/replay, stale epoch, alternate namespace, exception and timing shape, ambient discovery, and all 986 visibility cells—not merely whether a stage can deserialize a named value.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V5_ES01 binds exact external authority, proposal/context hashes, scope, and expiry; no internal artifact can mint, widen, refresh, or substitute human authority. V5_ES02 must prove directional support and repetition capabilities, including constant-shape taint receipts without leaking forbidden counts, identifiers, hashes, order, timing, cache, errors, or stale handles. V5_ES03 must route every arm through the sole writer and bind encoded masks/spans, batches, RNG, roots, dose, abort state, and excluded-state noninterference; treatment token identities may differ only in declared spans, while positions/counts and exogenous opportunity match. V2_ES04 is the cheapest CPU-only proof of nonzero-A/zero-B zero-effective-delta initialization and flowing gradient, with all-zero failure fixture, before model work. V2_ES05 must prove one FP32 merge, one BF16 rounding, deterministic immutable roots, equal tensor/tie inventory, no adapter residue, bounded symmetric error, and merged/unmerged parity. V5_ES06 must exercise each directional lineage boundary, root/verdict mismatch, fsync/restart/CAS/quarantine fault, epoch expiry, and retry class; full-head staleness may not be repaired by silently rebinding an old candidate. V2_ES07 must replay all T/D pairs, establish identical canonical action/outcome/admission/slot opportunity, audit the full prompt and target with independent coders, require the narrow computation-3 and computation-6 semantics, and keep D noninferior to M0 within -0.05. V5_ES08 must freeze the builder before downstream work and use a blindness auditor that sees only manifests and taint receipts; renamed policy-isomorphic or action-prescribing sources fail, and no audit-derived semantic value returns to construction. V5_ES09 must use fresh disposable executor/scorer/reporter paths for correct, none, irrelevant, and wrong advice clones, with closed transcripts, mechanically scored action/outcome, no writes or feedback, and Delta_R >= +0.05 on both canary roots. V5_ES10 must prove the fixed cursor emits byte-identical lessons at ages 1/9/17/25 under opposite histories, advances exactly once, cannot observe child or audit state, holds resources/opportunities fixed while allowing induced corpora to differ, and interprets Delta_F >= +0.03 only as fixed-curriculum-plus-SLEEP acceleration. V5_ES11 must keep adaptive package evaluation disposable and split, bind all parent information/effort, and interpret Delta_E >= +0.03 only as the selected ecological interaction. V5_ES12 must prove fixed reminders ignore behavior, adaptive state transitions use only frozen public criteria, repetition/control bytes cannot affect SLEEP, and only independently grounded child enactment enters ordinary evidence. V5_ES13 separately freezes storage, held-out extraction, and fresh use plus directional controls and preservation; scorer truth and scores never return to the child or lineage. V5_ES14 compares same-birth, same-later-evidence disposable cumulative and descendant-closure-ablation candidates plus a separately reported disjoint filler sensitivity, with no feedback and no unreplayed-retention claim. V2_ES15 crosses rank 8/16 with low/high equalized exposure only after compiler selection and supports capacity-by-exposure engineering only. V5_ES16 keeps cadence randomized as a total package, terminal standardized ledgers conditional, and executor/scorer/reporter outputs firewalled. V2_ES17 freezes binary Y, ages, normalized trapezoid AUC, +0.05/+0.03/-0.05 margins, root-level units, mixed-sign rerun, six-new-root confirmation, multiplicity, and cheapest-first spend order. V5_ES19 must enumerate all 986 cells and each capability's allowed operation, producer/consumer, epoch, lifecycle, and constant-shape behavior; it must also negative-test forging, replay, wrong operation, wrong epoch, ambient discovery, and covert outputs. V5_ES20 must inject all failure classes and concurrent-commit boundaries, preserve committed life/control/prior weights, quarantine derivatives, rebuild DREAM, and prove exact next ancestry; stale full-head CAS requires a new snapshot/compile rather than candidate rebase. V5_ES18 requires a fresh post-implementation independent reviewer, non-overriding advocate, exact external authority verification, and separately exact human GPU permission. V5_ES21 must bind an exhaustive action ID to exact prerequisite receipt roots, requested scope, artifact/destination class, and expiry, and fail closed on absence, mismatch, revocation, or newly registered routes. Its model-free gate-fixture bootstrap must be explicitly outside the guarded domain actions; otherwise requiring ES19/20/21 before implementation is circular. None of these tests is presently run or authorized.
assumptions: A visible matrix cell grants only the operation named in its capability ID for a schema-valid object and never grants ambient filesystem, network, process, reflection, enumeration, or cross-capability authority.
Epoch labels describe capability-handle leases rather than destruction of immutable artifacts; cross-stage consumers receive newly issued read-only or verify-only handles to sealed artifacts.
An equality or bind capability is non-dereferenceable, unforgeable, namespace-bound, and cannot be converted into a read, write, advance, transfer, or identifier-discovery capability.

A candidate binds the complete snapshot vector from which it was built; any concurrent full-head change makes its promotion CAS stale and requires quarantine plus a fresh compile rather than rebasing.
The fixed parent cursor is external monotone state with exactly-once advance semantics, while the fixed controller itself has no mutable memory or audit readback.

Scientific transcripts and scores are immutable sealed records; no executor, scorer, reporter, auditor, verifier, or release process shares mutable memory or an ambient storage namespace with a preceding stage.
External human authorization is authenticated, nonce-bound, scope-, artifact-, destination-, action-, and expiry-specific, and is neither reproducible nor renewable by repository code.

All writer, serializer, capability, receipt, transaction, cursor, cache, scorer, authority, action-registry, statistical, and GPU bytes remain separately frozen and scoped before any corresponding work.

ambiguities.question: What exact schema, issuer, producer and consumer cardinality, namespace, method surface, seal, attenuation rule, constant-shape result, and revocation transition defines each of the 58 named capabilities?
ambiguities.impact: Without these bytes, the 986-cell matrix is a policy table rather than a constructible least-authority mechanism, and ES19 cannot distinguish possession from actual operation authority.

ambiguities.question: When does each E1-E8 lease begin and end, which handles are single-use, how are immutable artifacts carried into later epochs, and what exact response occurs for copied, replayed, revoked, or stale handles?
ambiguities.impact: Artifacts intentionally cross named stages, so literal one-epoch existence conflicts with later audit/release use unless artifact lifetime and handle lifetime are explicitly separated.

ambiguities.question: Which declared stages issue E7 dependency manifests, taint receipts, lineage transaction receipts, E7 candidate-preservation evidence, E8 narrow attestations, and E8 release-root bindings, and what exact lossless or narrowing transforms connect them to earlier outputs?
ambiguities.impact: These read-side capabilities have no explicit producing or projection edges, leaving hidden authority-bearing sidecars outside the visibility product.

ambiguities.question: Does any concurrent life, parent, or repetition commit invalidate candidate promotion, how is the snapshot vector encoded, and is stale CAS classified as operational crash, source invalidity, or a distinct no-retry concurrency outcome?
ambiguities.impact: Refreshing CAS and promoting an old candidate would attach it to ancestry it did not observe; treating every concurrent wake as retryable could also violate the one-retry and same-data rules.

ambiguities.question: What immutable transcript and score closure schemas bind executor identity, active-weight root, public-input root, seed, completion, scorer version, hidden-truth root, and reporter provenance without exposing truth or scores upstream?
ambiguities.impact: A mutable, partial, substituted, or replayed transcript/score can collapse executor/scorer/reporter isolation despite correct matrix visibility.

ambiguities.question: What fixed-size attestation fields may each auditor emit, who signs and verifies them, and how are authorization freshness, revocation, root binding, scope, action, destination, expiry, and replay prevention encoded?
ambiguities.impact: An overbroad attestation can leak protected values, while an underspecified authorization or release binding permits root substitution, replay, scope widening, or exfiltration.

ambiguities.question: What exact action registry maps every affected action to prerequisite receipts, and what narrowly authorized model-free fixture scope can construct and test the gate and ES19/ES20 without already performing a guarded implementation action?
ambiguities.impact: ES19, ES20, and ES21 are each required before implementation but depend on implemented capability and transaction machinery, creating a circular prerequisite unless a non-domain bootstrap scope is explicit.

ambiguities.question: Which artifact classes, destinations, transfer protocols, publication/push operations, and idempotency rules can E8_RELEASE_CONTROLLER perform under each exact external authorization?
ambiguities.impact: An opaque target root without an artifact-class and destination binding could authorize transfer of a model, data, report, or unrelated repository object beyond the intended release scope.

ambiguities.question: Which exact writer, tokenizer, merge, serializer, support resolver, DREAM cache, pair generator, audit rubric, scorer, statistic, replay closure, and spend-order bytes instantiate the later packets?
ambiguities.impact: The architecture defines causal and authority roles, but reproducible execution and claims remain impossible until these choices are frozen before outcomes and independently reviewed.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal says every directional capability has one schema, producer/consumer set, epoch, and constant-shape behavior, but those definitions are not contained in the exact proposal bytes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Names plus visible/forbidden cells do not determine serialization, issuance, attenuation, permitted methods, lifecycle, error behavior, or anti-forgery/replay properties. Different implementations could satisfy the prose while creating materially different authority graphs.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before implementation ratification, bind a canonical per-capability registry with exact request/result schemas, issuers, producers, consumers, namespaces, operations, artifact and lease lifecycles, constant-shape failure classes, and denial tests; recompute the full matrix and ES19 fixtures from it.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The split audit/authority/release path is least-authority in intent but not closed because multiple E7/E8 read and bind capabilities have no declared producer or narrowing transform.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Dependency manifests, taint receipts, lineage receipts, E7 preservation evidence, narrow attestations, and release-root bindings otherwise require an undeclared sidecar with authority and visibility absent from the 17-stage product.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add explicit model-free producer/projection stages or exact external inputs for every such object, give each a write/append or verify-only capability, include those stages in the Cartesian matrix, and prohibit the projection from carrying semantic content or reusable upstream handles.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Requiring ES19, ES20, and ES21 before implementation is circular because ES19 and ES20 require capability, transaction, fault, and dispatcher machinery that does not yet exist.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A fail-closed gate cannot both prohibit all implementation and depend on its own implemented receipts. Leaving the bootstrap implicit creates an unregistered authority path that undermines the exhaustive-action claim.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Separate a minimal, exact, human-ratified, model-free gate-harness and fake-fixture implementation scope from all guarded domain actions. Use it to produce ES19/ES20 evidence and install ES21; only then permit separately scoped domain implementation, with model/tokenizer/data/adapter/GPU and release actions still forbidden.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: An exact target root plus authority verdict is insufficient to define safe release unless artifact class, destination, operation, protocol, scope, and expiry are also equality-bound.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Root-only opaque transfer permits type confusion and destination substitution even when the controller cannot dereference content.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Make the authorization and verdict bind a canonical release tuple of artifact root, artifact class, destination identity, transfer operation, protocol, requested scope, nonce, expiry, and one-shot/idempotency key; require the release receipt to echo that tuple without becoming an upstream or scientific input.

open_questions: Does Rohin agree that this interpretation authorizes no implementation, model or tokenizer execution, data or benchmark generation, adapter/checkpoint work, GPU/resource use, scientific execution or claim, publication/push, release, or intake transition?

Should exact v5 bytes 5349b32fbf7ebf34958e8ae43bed1ad735eb18ca7db388f71ff252d43b8f6e5d be returned for rework until the capability registry, epoch/receipt closure, transaction concurrency, action-gate bootstrap, and release tuple are bound?

If reworked, must every persistent artifact receive a new epoch-scoped read-only or verify-only handle rather than carrying the original write, bind, advance, dereference, or transfer authority across stages?
Must any stale full-head CAS quarantine the candidate and require a fresh snapshot and compile, with no promotion-time rebase onto concurrent life, parent, or repetition commits?
Will release authorization bind artifact class, exact root, destination, operation, protocol, scope, nonce, expiry, and idempotency in addition to an authority verdict?

Will all later implementation, evidence, review, GPU, claim, publication, push, and release scopes remain separately exact and human-authorized, with any material graph, loop, visibility, test, or claim change restarting deliberation?
